Directly independently enumerated/automaton-derived coefficients (r=1..8,n<=125) and definition checks support rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: A genuinely parameterized family of constrained symbolic sources receives an exact length-and-universality distribution, not a single finite table. The strict inequality μ1<1/3<μr for every r>=2 yields an unexpected qualitative reversal: forbidding long zero runs improves typical subsequence coverage while forbidding 00 worsens it. These are natural quantitative benchmarks for constrained sequence generation and exact fixed-length universal-string counts, motivated directly by the regular-language universality counting literature.
